taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-02 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-02
Curve type: Q-type (resistivity decreases monotonically with depth: ρ1>ρ2>ρ3>ρ4>ρ5>ρ6)
Aquifer depth: 73.79 m and below (Layer 6, ρ = 22.8 Ω·m, base not reached)
Recommendation: Plan drilling to at least 75–80 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity zone beginning at 73.79 m, which likely represents a weathered/fractured, water-bearing horizon; collect cuttings and run a short pump test once this zone is intersected to confirm aquifer yield and quality.
